claims.claim: The government understood the treaties as surrender of the land claim; First Nations leaders understood them as agreements to share the land.
Chief Chateh delayed signing to protect his people's traditional lands into the future; Ahnassay reports an account he heard, not an eyewitness observation.
The language question on printed p27 is the textbook narrator's framing outside Ahnassay's quotation.
Interpreting required conveying larger implications and bridging a culture gap as well as a language gap; the passage alone does not establish every interpreter's intention or conduct.
Archibald promised continued hunting/fishing/trapping rights; the promise was not included in the written treaty.
